sources.title: LeWM Self-Driving — A Latent World Model for Autonomous Driving
sources.snippet: End-to-end world modelling for highway driving We adapt the LeWorldModel (LeWM) JEPA framework to the Comma2k19 self-driving dataset. The model learns to predict future driving scenes in a compact latent space from raw 224×224 pixel observations and vehicle control signals, without any reconstruction objective or pretrained vision backbone.
